name: Speculative Progressive Raycasting
aliases: progressive algorithm for implicit isosurface raycasting
progressive wavefront traversal with ray-block speculation
definition: An implicit isosurface raycasting algorithm that progressively traverses a wavefront of rays through a block-compressed volume to reduce memory consumption and achieve scalable rendering performance on lightweight devices.
summary: Speculative Progressive Raycasting is a GPU algorithm for interactive isosurface rendering that progressively traverses compressed volumes and speculatively processes extra blocks to maximize GPU utilization.
